RATIONALE (PC-IAC-022, docs/cd-pipeline.md §7):
1. Workload destroyed first: terminates event processors, compute, and ingress before shared resources
2. Security destroyed second: removes workload IAM roles, policies, and WAF rules while preserving audit keys
3. Network destroyed third: dismantles subnets, Transit Gateway attachments, and VPC after traffic has stopped
4. State backend preserved to the very end: tracks and proves destruction; state is never destroyed first!

MANDATORY DATA RETENTION GUARDS (Case Statement, ADR-003, ASM-098):
• 5-Year Telemetry Retention: DynamoDB Point-in-Time Recovery & S3 Object Lock in Compliance Mode (cannot be deleted)
• 5-Year Central Audit Archive: CloudTrail WORM archive in Security Account under 'audit' CMK (SCP protected)
• State Backend Safeguard: Remote S3 state bucket MUST remain intact during teardown; state is never destroyed first!

div.div:
REVERSE DEPENDENCY ORDER RATIONALE (PC-IAC-022, docs/cd-pipeline.md §7):
1. Workload destroyed first: terminates event processors, compute, and ingress before shared resources
2. Security destroyed second: removes workload IAM roles, policies, and WAF rules while preserving audit keys
3. Network destroyed third: dismantles subnets, Transit Gateway attachments, and VPC after traffic has stopped
4. State backend preserved to the very end: tracks and proves destruction; state is never destroyed first!
NOTE: Proposed procedure for environment retirement; repository delivery is plan-only (AGENTS.md §4).
